_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.157 (K'Erin profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)
_book_notes: p.157 prices K'Erin Civilian 6 and Epic 35; the p.178 summary table prints 8 and 32. p.133 step 2 takes the profile from the Lifeforms page, so 6 and 35 are used

species.description: Proud warrior species who excel in close combat. K'Erin value honor and martial skill above all.

traits.name: Brawlers
traits.description: K’Erin sergeants and individual figures make two close assault attacks per round and may use any weapon carried with either attack.

traits.name: Disciplined
traits.description: K’Erin add +1 to all Morale tests.
